subject: Lumen Data renewal: commit mix proposal + rate smoothing request
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@lumendata.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal proposal and commit mix idea

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for a great conversation yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled together an initial renewal worksheet that shows two pathways: (A) keep your existing committed level but add a mid-tier burst pool for peak events, and (B) reallocate 20% of the commit into a lower-rate non-guaranteed pool to smooth monthly spend while allowing predictable baseline performance.

Attached: renewal_proposal_v1.xlsx — it contains the pricing ladder, illustrative monthly bills, and an optional 6-month price-hold if you commit to the blended mix.

Quick ask: can you share a 12‑month usage forecast (monthly peak and avg) so we can tune the burst size? If you approve pathway B I can route for credit approval.

Thanks — Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Torres <emma@lumendata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and commit mix idea

Mina —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Your Pathway B looks interesting — smoothing spend is a priority for finance here. Attaching our internal forecast for the renewal window (lumendata_12mo_forecast.xlsx). A few asks from procurement: can Redwood offer a 4‑month price hold at the blended rate (we're trying to avoid mid-Q re-budgets), and can you commit to a 2:1 burst/commit ratio for up to 3 months during known seasonality?

Also looping in procurement (procurement@lumendata.com) so they can start paperwork. From our side we prefer a single contract amendment rather than multiple SOWs.

Best,
Emma
Head of Platform — Lumen Data
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal and commit mix idea 

Team — forwarding Lumen's forecast and requests. Key asks: 4‑month price hold at the blended rate, and temporary burst allowance at 2:1 for up to 3 months. They prefer a single amendment.

What I need: (1) approval range on discount / credits if we offer the 4‑month hold, (2) confirmation from solutions/SE on whether a 2:1 burst/commit for 3 months is safe from reliability/cost perspective, (3) a suggested DocuSign-friendly amendment.

Emma is generally happy with Pathway B (blend). I suggested we might offset the price‑hold with a modest usage credit or one-time onboarding credit.

Attachment: lumendata_12mo_forecast.xlsx (from customer)

— Mina
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal and commit mix idea

Mina / Marissa —

Reviewed their 12‑month forecast. Technically, a 2:1 burst allowance for up to 3 months is feasible if we: (a) pin an explicit burst CU ceiling per region, (b) require pre-notification for sustained >24hr bursts, and (c) toggle burst to a pay-as-you-go price that's higher than committed tokens. That keeps performance predictable while protecting us from unmetered spikes.

I attached a short note (capacity_response.pdf) showing expected GPU-days under the burst scenario and an ops-runbook snippet for handoffs during seasonality. My recommendation: accept the 4‑month price hold only if we recover via either a 6% blended discount cap or a one-time onboarding/true‑up credit (whichever legal prefers).

— Vivek
Solutions Engineering
Attachment: capacity_response.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-27T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal and commit mix idea

Team —

I reviewed Vivek's analysis. Approve moving forward with Pathway B under the following commercial guardrails:
- 4‑month price hold at the blended rate (we'll put a hard expiration date and auto‑revert to standard ladder thereafter)
- Cap discount exposure to 6% blended over the first year OR provide a one-time credit equal to two weeks of forecasted committed usage (whichever the customer prefers)
- Burst allowed at 2:1 for up to 3 months with a higher transient rate for burst tokens and a regional burst ceiling; Ops must be notified if sustained >24h (per Vivek)
- Single amendment + DocuSign; legal to review standard amendment language and include an explicit true‑up clause

Mina — please present both options (6% discount vs two‑week credit) in a clean final worksheet. If customer picks the credit route, we can process as a one-time invoice credit (no change to list rates). If they pick the 6% discount, run numbers with finance for margin impact and get explicit sign-off.

Marissa
Director, Renewals
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma@lumendata.com>, Procurement <procurement@lumendata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and commit mix idea — final options and next steps

Emma / procurement team —

Thanks for the forecast and patience while we internally validated. Attached is a final worksheet (renewal_final_v2.xlsx) that lays out the two commercial paths we discussed:

Option 1 — 6% blended discount for 12 months + 4‑month price hold at the blended rate; burst policy: 2:1 for up to 3 months with regional caps and a burst token surcharge as noted (ops notification required for >24h).

Option 2 — No recurring discount; one-time credit equal to two weeks of committed usage applied at signing, plus the 4‑month price hold. All other burst terms same as above.

Next steps:
- Please indicate which option you prefer and confirm the regional burst ceilings in the attached worksheet.
- If Option 1, procurement will need a short memo to legal; if Option 2, we will prepare the credit note and single amendment.
- DocuSign envelope link for the amendment/draft: https://www.docusign.com/track/abcdef123456 (placeholder — will populate once you confirm option).

Attachments: renewal_final_v2.xlsx; docusign_lumendata_renewal_link.txt (placeholder link above)

Looking forward — Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
